atts.text: Serengeti biome-sync technology meets real-time ethological intelligence. We track, map, and protect the apex predators of our age—through acoustic monitoring arrays, non-invasive genomic sampling, and satellite telemetry at 120-frame fidelity.
Sub-20g solar-harvesting collars with dual-frequency GNSS. Sends location pings every 4 seconds. Waterproof to 30m. Operates across -40°C to 65°C biome ranges.
900-node IoT environmental mesh measuring soil moisture, canopy density, prey density indices, and fire-risk thermoclines. Feeds predictive migration AI.
Environmental DNA collection from water sources, scat, and hair snares. Full genetic profiles without tranquilization—preserving behavioral integrity across the study period.

Our biome-synchronization platform integrates satellite multispectral imagery, ground-truth sensor arrays, and machine-learning habitat models into a living cartographic intelligence. Updated every 2 hours. Predictive horizon: 72 hours.
